description: Undo what Godotwright wrote, newest first: scene and project edits, renames (moved files go back), migrations, fixes and model builds each keep the files as they were, in .godot/godotwright/journal/ (the last 40 writes). `steps` undoes that many writes (default 1); `list` only shows them. A file changed after the write (by hand or by another tool) stops the undo there, so your later edits are never lost silently; `force` undoes anyway. Use it when a write made things worse, instead of repairing by hand.

force.description: undo even when a file changed after the write; those changes are lost

list.description: only list the writes that can be undone

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

name: godot_undo
title: Undo the last Godotwright writes
